<span id="choosing-between-discord-paths"></span>
== Choosing between Discord paths ==

<code>awdiscord</code> is the full Discord product. <code>adk home serve</code> is the lighter way to reach ''your own'' agent from many channels. They are different tools for different jobs; a wiki page like this is where that distinction belongs, in one sentence, rather than being inferred from two READMEs.
